description: Wave 6D-11 strictly read-only console probes (45 probes across 4 batches) covering FormLists (FLST) mutations/queries, mod load-order/form-resolution/identity/EditorID/name APIs; xNVSE/JIP array construction, mutation, erase, resize, iteration, copy/deepcopy, ar_Cat, slicing, generators, higher-order callbacks, and sorting/unique; string sv_* replace/find/count/substring/erase/compare/split/numeric/regex/ValidateRegex/hex/ASCII and strictly read-only GMST/INI getters; and JIP AuxVars, RefMaps (including AuxVarEraseAll & RefMapGetAll), trig/arc/log/pow/sqrt/fmod/floor/ceil/round/min/max/clamp/lerp, RNG, and bitwise operations.
